page_notes.crib: The Crib is an ESPN NFL 2K5 feature and not an NFL Street concept, so this page stays empty here on purpose.
page_notes.gameplay: The boot executable is SLUS_208.41, 3,257,248 bytes, sha256 1b5cecc...1da7728b, PCSX2 CRC 03C2C5B1. No patch site on it has been located by this project, and every site is per-title research: none of the immediates Madden 09's playbook-editor caps patch uses was found here, because they are addresses in a different executable. So this page carries no lane rather than a scaffold with nothing behind it -- a pnach writer with an empty translation table would be a control that can only refuse.
page_notes.saves: NFL Street writes its progress to a PlayStation 2 memory card and there is no save artefact on the disc for this page to read. Nothing has been captured from a memory card for SLUS-20841 in this project, so this page carries no lane rather than one that could only refuse. What would lift it is one exported save; the module document says what the reader would need to establish from it.
